method: Read-only comparison of every one of 451 named GP entries with original 300dpi source-page images, viewed directly page by page. Full-resolution crops resolved ambiguous letter stems. Existing transcription was visible; this is not blinded, independent gold creation or held-out statistical accuracy estimation. No external name lookup, fuzzy matching or automatic OCR substitution.
baseline_preservation: Every original named-entry reading is embedded below. Canonical file was not edited by this reviewer.
coordination_disclosure: Pudukurichi was independently flagged before the transcriber reported eight concurrent high-resolution corrections. The other seven proposed corrections were then separately checked on the original images. A provisional Katagaram proposal was explicitly retracted after a full-resolution crop showed Kattagaram.
limitations: Visual consistency is not a statistical accuracy guarantee.
Category punctuation is normalized in the canonical readings; this review checks caste/women/general meaning rather than exact punctuation.
Several scanned tables have curved rules or category text displaced relative to name baselines. Pairing follows printed sequence and section boundaries; flags preserve this layout risk.
The 451 entries are amendment entries, not a complete statewide GP roster or elected-person observations.
Five serial-addressed unnamed GP category substitutions, district-heading rename details and the later union/district-chair lists are outside this named-entry audit.

rejected_proposals.reason: Whole-page display visually merged the two t stems; original-resolution crop resolves both. Proposal withdrawn; retain canonical spelling.

pages.scope_note: Context/office amendment cover; no named GP entry in reviewed transcription.
